title: PriceBar
description: obs.price_bar r1: one daily bar of one instrument under one basis; a restated day is a new adjust_epoch row, an existing row is never changed.

basis.description: trades: traded prices as printed; adjusted_last: last prices adjusted for splits and dividends.

adjust_epoch.description: Epoch of the pull, from 1; a restated day is written again under the next epoch, and readers take the highest epoch of an instrument and basis.

volume.description: Volume as decimal text; null when the source gives none (adjusted_last rows). The key is always present.

currency.description: Currency code of the prices, for example USD.

received_at.description: Instant the row was received, UTC.
